record.question: If root zone depth is 2m, existing water content is 5%,the dry density of soil is 1.5g/cm2, water applied to the soil is 500m3, water loss due to evaporation etc is 10% and the area of the plot is 100m2. What will be the field capacity of the soil
record.explanation: Stem/options verified against printed page 8 (printed as Q81; bank's qnum 82/page 9 differs but text matches verbatim). With the printed 500 m^3 applied, net storage = 450 m^3 = 4.5 m depth over 100 m^2 against only 300 t of dry soil (100 m^2 x 2 m x 1.5 t/m^3), giving a 150% water-content increase (FC ~155%), which is impossible and matches no option. With the evidently intended 50 m^3, net depth = 0.45 m, i.e. 450 kg water per 3000 kg dry soil = 15%, so field capacity = 5% + 15% = 20%. Medium confidence due to the apparent typo in the printed water volume.
